load_bearing_rule: seat 0 (recorder/chair own claim) plus the two highest seats {n-2, n-1}
chair_beats_when: chair fraction is strictly greater than flat fraction (Fraction compare, not float)
flat_read_order: unprioritized seat order 1,2,3,...; no agenda so load-bearing seats are not preferred
notes: Load-bearing claims are placed at the far end of the unprioritized cursor so the missing agenda is observable. Placing them at seats 0,1,2 would make flat never drop them under this budget and would game the metric.
